rationale: The last candle shows a massive volume spike (674K shares in one minute) driving price to the session high at $27.08, with the stock now sitting at 98.4% of its daily range — this is an extended, climactic move with no news catalyst to explain it. Chasing a long at the high after a parabolic spike carries extreme reversal risk, while shorting into what could be a genuine breakout with no clear resistance overhead is equally dangerous. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the ambiguous nature of the spike and the already-elevated position in the range.
